newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bank BOS plans to pay 1996 dividend.
newsitem.headline: Polish bank BOS plans to pay 1996 dividend.

text.p: Polish Bank Ochrony Srodowiska SA (BOS), which starts bourse trade on Monday, plans to pay a 1996 dividend, the bank's president said on Thursday.
"Regular dividend payouts are a part of the bank's strategy for 1996-98 and the management will propose to pay dividend for 1996," Jozef Koziol told Reuters in an interview.
He said he could not yet give the amount of the payout.
In its issue prospectus the bank said it would earmark up to 40 percent of its 1996 net profit for dividend.
According to preliminary figures BOS earned net 50 million zlotys in 1996. -- Malgorzata Rzepka +48 22 653 9700
